blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Synthetic-aperture imaging (SAI) removes occluders such as foliage by integrating many views of a scene along a camera path. It has so far been used mainly with frame cameras. We ask whether an event camera has advantages for SAI, and answer the question in simulation, where both sensors see exactly the same scene and the same camera movement. A densely rendered Blender sequence is turned into frames with an EMVA~1288 noise model of an industrial global-shutter camera, and into an event stream with the v2e simulator parameterized like a Sony IMX636. The frames are integrated with the existing airborne optical sectioning renderer. For the events we add a new integration path that projects every single event onto the focal plane at its own interpolated pose, so no events have to be binned into frames. We compare the two sensors in three main runs and an additional dark high-speed test. In a bright scene at 25,m/s the frame camera records only three images on the path and cannot remove the occluder, while the event camera reconstructs the target, even after an event-rate controller drops most of its events to fit the camera link. At the same speed in a 5,lux scene the event camera no longer resolves the target either. In a 5,lux scene at 5,m/s both sensors reconstruct the target at similar quality. We also compare the data one traversal of the aperture costs. At high speed the capped event stream still shows the target at the same data volume as the three frames. At 1,m/s we compare both cameras at two matched data budgets, and there the event camera has no advantage over the frame camera in reconstruction quality. The data rate of the event camera depends on the scene and is highest exactly in the fast bright scenes where it is needed most.

blocks.en: 1. Introduction
blocks.zh: 一、导 言 导言

blocks.en:
Synthetic-aperture imaging (SAI) is a technique used to see through occlusions, such as leaves on a tree.
It fuses images captured by a moving camera and requires the 3D position or pose of the camera for each image to be known.
With the 3D positions of each frame and a given distance from the camera, it is possible to focus on objects behind the occlusion, while the occluder, which is positioned at a different distance from the camera, is averaged out. Airborne optical sectioning (AOS) has shown this on a drone system that can be used to see objects of interest on the floor of a forest ( Kurmi et al., 2018 ) .
In addition, this has also been used on ground-moving systems that are able to look through bushes or other vertical occluders ( Bimber et al., 2025 ) .
The technique has been mainly shown on frame-based sensors, including thermal cameras. However, frame cameras are limited by their frame rate. If not enough frames are captured, the occlusion removal does not work.
Exposure must also be managed carefully to avoid motion blur.

合成-孔径成像(英語:SAI)是一种通过嵌入物,如树上的叶子来观察的技术.
它将移动相机捕获的图像引信,需要相机的3D位置或姿势才能知道每个图像.

此外,这还被用于地面移动系统,这些系统能够通过灌木丛或其他垂直渗透物来查看(Bimber等人,2025年)。
该技术主要在基于帧的传感器上展示,包括热相机. 然而,帧相机受到其帧速率的限制. 如果捕捉到的帧不够多,则隔离清除无效.
接触也必须谨慎管理,以避免运动模糊。

blocks.en:
Event cameras are often proposed as an alternative sensor that has advantages over classic frame-based sensors ( Lichtsteiner et al., 2008 ; Gallego et al., 2022 ) .
In contrast to frame-based cameras, event cameras record lighting changes over a certain threshold and therefore have no frame rate. Each pixel reports changes independent of the pixels around it.
Especially in difficult lighting conditions and in scenarios where motion blur is an issue, it has been demonstrated that event cameras perform better ( Sun et al., 2021 ; Rebecq et al., 2021 ) .
Also, in many scenarios, they have a bandwidth advantage since event cameras only record pixels if something changes, and frame cameras have a static bandwidth ( Gallego et al., 2022 ) .
blocks.zh:
事件摄像头经常被提议作为替代传感器,比经典的帧式传感器具有优势(Lichtstener等人,2008年;Gallego等人,2022年)。
与基于帧的相机形成对比的是,事件相机记录的照明量在一定阈值以上发生变化,因此没有帧速率. 每个像素报告都独立于周围的像素而变化.
特别是在困难的照明条件和运动模糊是一个问题的情景中,已经证明事件摄像头表现更好(Sun等人,2021年;Rebecq等人,2021年)。
另外,在许多情景中,它们具有带宽优势,因为事件摄像头只记录有变化时的像素,帧摄像头具有静态带宽(Gallego等人,2022年).

blocks.en:
We study the question of whether event cameras have advantages over frame cameras in the context of synthetic-aperture imaging. We use simulation with a shared trajectory and scene to compare both modalities. Both simulation pipelines start with a dense Blender render and are then fed into sensor models. For the event camera simulation, we use an event camera simulator (v2e ( Hu et al., 2021 ) ).
For the frame sensor simulation, we use an EMVA 1288 ( European Machine Vision Association, 2021 ) -parameterized simulation. The EMVA parameters come from an industrial global-shutter camera. The frame simulation is then forwarded to the existing SAI technique.
The existing SAI takes images, so events could only be used by binning them back into frames. Instead we add an SAI path that projects every single event at its own interpolated pose, so it also works with arbitrary 6-DoF poses. Event-based SAI has so far been shown on a linear rail ( Zhang et al., 2021 ; Yu et al., 2022 ) .
The simulation lets us sweep different speed and lighting scenarios and compare the performance of both modalities.

我们在合成孔径成像中研究事件摄像头是否比帧摄像头有优势的问题. 我们用一个共享的轨迹和场景模拟两种模式。 这两种模拟管道都从密集的Blender渲染开始,然后输入传感器模型。 对于事件相机模拟,我们使用事件相机模拟器(v2e(Hu等人,2021年)).
对于帧传感器模拟,我们使用EMVA 1288(欧洲机器视觉协会,2021年)-参数化模拟. EMVA参数来源于工业全球Shutter相机. 然后将帧模拟传输到现有的SAI技术.

blocks.en:
We evaluate three runs. The first two cover the two conditions in which event cameras are expected to help: fast motion and low light. The high-speed scenario is simulated in bright light and at a camera speed of 25 25 m/s. In this scenario, the event camera provides a usable result, while the frame camera, running at its maximum full-resolution frame rate (Section 4 ), records only three images across the aperture, which is not enough to suppress the occluders.
However, we had to simulate an event rate controller for this result to be valid, since the event simulator produced too many events, exceeding the bandwidth of the link of a real camera. Even with the limited bandwidth, the event camera still provides a usable result. This advantage is limited to good light. In the dark at the same speed the event camera does not resolve the target either (Section 6 ). For a drone with a 30 30 fps camera the gain in flight speed is about a factor of 17 17 on our aperture.
In the low-light scenario, the camera speed is set much lower, at 5 5 m/s. For this scenario, no decisive winner could be found. This is partly because we simulate a higher-resolution event camera, and such cameras generally do not perform as well in low light as lower-resolution event sensors ( Gehrig and Scaramuzza, 2022 ) . The frame camera images are quite noisy, but the SAI reconstruction is able to remove most of that noise through averaging.
The third run is in the bright scene at 1 1 m/s, where the frame camera has enough views. There we compare both cameras at matched data budgets, and the event camera shows no advantage.

blocks.en: 2. Related Work
blocks.zh: 2. 相关工作

blocks.en:
Seeing through occluders by combining many viewpoints goes back to the
Stanford camera array. Vaish et al. ( Vaish et al., 2004 ) showed that
a dense grid of conventional video cameras can be combined and refocused
as if they were one wide-aperture sensor. Wilburn et
al. ( Wilburn et al., 2005 ) built the full 100-camera system and used
it for synthetic-aperture video, blurring foliage away to focus on a
subject behind it. Airborne optical sectioning (AOS) ( Kurmi et al., 2018 ) brought the principle to a single low-cost drone, which made it more
practical and easier to use. The drone flies over a point of interest
for about 30 to 100 m and collects hundreds of video frames. After
that, the camera poses are calculated in post-processing. Later this
principle was also showcased with thermal cameras. Combining many
thermal images revealed heat signatures through trees that no single
image would have shown ( Kurmi et al., 2019b ) . Another project using this principle was a
fully autonomous drone that was able to locate 38 of 42 hidden persons
in field trials ( Schedl et al., 2021 ) . Most recently,
synthetic-aperture imaging has been transferred to ground
robots ( Bimber et al., 2025 ) . In all of this work, the sensor is
a frame camera.

blocks.en:
Event cameras have also been used for synthetic-aperture imaging.
Zhang et al. ( Zhang et al., 2021 ) mounted a DAVIS346 on a motorized
linear rail and moved it past a wooden fence at a constant speed of
about 0.2 0.2 m/s. The events are refocused with a single shift that
follows from the camera speed and the target depth, and a hybrid
spiking and convolutional network, trained on their own recordings,
then reconstructs the hidden target from the refocused events. The
frame comparison in this work uses the APS frames of the same
DAVIS346. Liao et al. ( Liao et al., 2022 ) combined both modalities,
using the frames for the texture that events miss and the events for
the see-through signal under dense occlusion. Yu et
al. ( Yu et al., 2022 ) extended the method with a network that
estimates the camera speed and target depth itself and enlarged the
dataset. These all work on a single axis and at table-top scale. Our
implementation, like AOS, works with six degrees of freedom. It is an
event extension of the AOS software and therefore also works without a
trained model.

blocks.en:
Event cameras are an alternative sensor category. Their advantages over
frame cameras have been demonstrated directly in side-by-side
comparisons, though for tasks other than synthetic-aperture imaging.
Delbruck and Lang ( Delbruck and Lang, 2013 ) established the
low-latency advantage of events for situations where a fast reaction is
crucial. Sun et al. ( Sun et al., 2021 ) mounted an event and a
frame sensor on one quadrotor and compared them across different
scenarios, finding the event camera’s advantage concentrated in fast
motion and low light. Gehrig and Scaramuzza ( Gehrig and Scaramuzza, 2022 ) showed, however, that these advantages depend on the specific sensor and also on the resolution of the sensor:
high-resolution event cameras produce more noise events in dim scenes
and can saturate their readout bandwidth in busy scenarios. Newer sensors therefore include an
event-rate controller that drops events ( Prophesee and Sony Semiconductor Solutions, 2021 ) , a mechanism we reproduce in our ERC model.

blocks.en:
This low-light weakness has a physical origin. Since the original
DVS ( Lichtsteiner et al., 2008 ) , it is known that the performance of event cameras is strongly influenced by the illumination level they are used in:
an event pixel is driven by the light it
receives, so in scenes with a lot of light it reacts quickly and in lower-light scenes it
gets slow and cannot follow fast brightness changes and its output
gets noisier ( Graça et al., 2023 ; Graça and Delbruck, 2021 ) . Smaller
pixels in higher resolution systems collect less light and therefore
slow down earlier as the light decreases ( Gehrig and Scaramuzza, 2022 ) .
How fast a pixel can still follow brightness changes is expressed by a
single number, its cutoff frequency.
The event generation model we use needs this number to simulate a
certain light condition, but for the current-generation sensor we
model ( Finateu et al., 2020 ) , no exact measurement of it at low
light exists ( McReynolds et al., 2024 ) . But the manufacturer does
specify the pixel latency at specific lux
levels ( Prophesee and Sony Semiconductor Solutions, 2021 ) . We therefore derive the cutoff frequency
from the latency specification and choose a value below both
estimates we have.

blocks.en:
There are several simulators that turn a video into events. They all
use the same base idea: the video is processed frame by frame, and
then for each pixel the simulator checks if the brightness has changed
by more than a contrast threshold since the last event. If it has, an
event is written out. The main difference between the simulators is how
much of the real pixel they model on top of this.
ESIM ( Rebecq et al., 2018 ) and vid2e ( Gehrig et al., 2020 ) use an
ideal pixel that does nothing more than this comparison, so the events
they produce have no noise. v2e ( Hu et al., 2021 ) goes further and also
models the weaknesses of a real DVS pixel. The photoreceptor bandwidth,
the threshold mismatch, shot and leak noise and the refractory period
are all parameters that can be set. What cannot be set is the light
level of the scene. In v2e a lighting condition is simulated by giving
these parameters the values a real pixel would have under that light.
For low light this mainly means a low photoreceptor bandwidth and more
noise. Our night study is exactly the case where these weaknesses
matter most ( Graça et al., 2023 ) , and therefore we use v2e.

blocks.en:
Another event-camera advantage that is reported often is dynamic
range. In comparison to a normal frame camera there is no uniform
exposure for all pixels. Instead each pixel responds logarithmically,
and therefore a much higher dynamic range can be recorded. A DVS
covers 120 dB within one scene ( Lichtsteiner et al., 2008 ) without
exposure control ( Gallego et al., 2022 ) , against 72 dB for the
frame camera we use as reference ( European Machine Vision Association, 2021 ; Basler AG, 2024 ) .
This has been shown many times for scenes that saturate or starve a
frame camera, such as tunnel exits and headlight
glare ( Rebecq et al., 2021 ; Sun et al., 2021 ; Liu et al., 2024 ) . This could definitely be an advantage in some
scenarios for SAI, but a multi-image system can
also expose each image differently and combine
them ( Wilburn et al., 2005 ) . The event simulator we use, however,
does not support HDR, since its input consists of 8-bit frames, and
therefore our simulation does not test this question. But this
advantage should definitely be taken into consideration when deciding
which sensor to use.

blocks.en: 3. Method
blocks.zh: 3个 方法

blocks.en:
The pipeline has three stages (Figure 1 ). First, one
camera trajectory past the occluded scene is rendered densely in Blender,
together with the camera pose of every sample. Second, this rendering is
fed into two sensor models: a frame-camera model that turns groups of
samples into exposed, noisy images, and an event-camera model that turns
the sample sequence into an event stream. Third, each output is
integrated on the same focal plane. The frames use the existing SAI of
the AOS renderer, and for the events we add a new SAI path that projects
every single event onto the focal plane. The rendering in Blender, the
movement of the camera and the focal plane are shared, so the difference
between the two results comes from the sensor model and its
reconstruction. The following subsections describe each stage.

blocks.en:
The input to both sensor models is a single densely sampled Blender
rendering of one camera trajectory past the occluded scene. The path of
the camera forms the synthetic aperture. The trajectory is built from a
chain of movement commands. Each command translates the camera over a
specified distance, with optional parameters for rotation and elevation
changes. Consequently, a combination of these commands can generate many
different sequences of camera poses. The animation is sampled at N N positions and each sample is rendered as an 8-bit grayscale image,
matching the monochrome sensors we model, together with its camera pose.
For every rendered frame the camera pose from Blender, which places the
camera in the world, is inverted into the world-to-camera view matrix
expected by the reconstruction. This requires remapping Blender’s Z Z -up coordinate convention to the renderer’s Y Y -up, Z Z -forward one.
All poses are collected in a single JSON file, which is then used by the
SAI reconstruction.

blocks.en: 3.2. Event-Camera Model
blocks.zh: 3.2. 事件-卡梅拉模型

blocks.en:
The event camera simulation uses v2e ( Hu et al., 2021 ) to convert the
densely rendered frames into the event stream a dynamic vision sensor
(DVS) ( Lichtsteiner et al., 2008 ) would produce. Frames are read one at
a time, and for each pixel the simulator calculates the following. First,
the log of the brightness value of each pixel is calculated, since event
cameras process brightness relatively. Then this log signal is sent into
a low-pass filter that models the pixel’s bandwidth restrictions.
Finally, events are generated from the filtered signal wherever
the signal goes over the threshold.

blocks.en:
When an event camera pixel receives light, a photocurrent is induced,
and the photoreceptor converts this current into a logarithmic voltage.
The time constant of this conversion is inversely proportional to the
photocurrent ( Hu et al., 2021 ; Lichtsteiner et al., 2008 ) . With less light
there is less photocurrent, the time constant becomes longer, and the
bandwidth of the pixel drops, so pixels react quickly in bright light
and sluggishly in dim light ( Hu et al., 2021 ; Graça et al., 2023 ) .
Therefore the photoreceptor can be modeled using a low-pass filter,
which is what v2e does. The event sampling itself is set after the
low-pass filter, and therefore the events are generated on a smoothed
signal of the rendered frames ( Hu et al., 2021 ) . The parameter cutoff_hz sets the corner frequency of this filter, and v2e
scales the filter per pixel with its brightness, so cutoff_hz specifies the bandwidth of a bright pixel and darker pixels respond
proportionally slower for the same cutoff setting. If cutoff_hz is low enough, finer structures, like the spokes of
a bike, produce fewer or no events. This is the reason why in lower
light the event stream loses detail. cutoff_hz is not a
parameter of the sensor alone, but a combination of the event camera,
its bias settings and the brightness of the
scene ( Graça et al., 2023 ; Hu et al., 2021 ) . How we choose its value
per lighting condition is described in Section 4 .

adds the non-idealities of a real sensor: every pixel gets a slightly
different threshold, pixels fire random noise events at a rate that
depends on the light, some pixels fire leak events without any input,
and a pixel cannot fire again within a short refractory time.

blocks.en: 3.3. Frame-Camera Model
blocks.zh: 3.3. 框架-卡梅拉模型

blocks.en: The frame camera simulation reuses the same rendered frames as the event simulation. The simulation has two steps. The first step takes the shutter speed and applies motion blur based on it. The second step applies noise based on the shutter speed and the EMVA 1288 camera model ( European Machine Vision Association, 2021 ) . This is a standardized model and many manufacturers publish parameters for it ( European Machine Vision Association, 2021 ; Basler AG, 2024 ) .
blocks.zh: 帧相机模拟重用与事件模拟相同的渲染帧. 模拟有两步. 第一步采取百叶窗速度,并据此应用运动模糊. 第二步应用基于百叶窗速度和EMVA 1288相机模型的噪声(欧洲机器视野协会,2021年). 这是一个标准化的模型,许多厂商为它发布参数(欧洲机器视野协会,2021年;Basler AG,2024年).

blocks.en: The rendered frames are sRGB encoded, so we first convert them back to linear brightness. Only in linear space can light from several frames be added up correctly. Each camera frame is then the average of all render frames that lie inside its exposure time. This is the common way to get motion blur from densely rendered sharp frames ( Nah et al., 2017 ) . The camera frame gets the pose of the render frame in the middle of its exposure. The exposure cannot be longer than the time between two frames, since the sensor has to read out before the next frame starts. So for darker scenes the capped exposure results in more noise. In SAI noise is generally preferred to motion blur, since the motion blur cannot be averaged out.
blocks.zh: 渲染的帧是sRGB编码的,所以我们首先将它们转换回线性亮度. 只有在线性空间中,才能正确添加多个帧的光线. 每个相机框是其曝光时间内所有渲染帧的平均值。 这是从高强度的锐框中模糊运动的常见方法(Nah等人,2017年). 相机帧在其曝光的中间获得渲染帧的姿势. 曝光时间不能超过两个帧之间的时间,因为传感器必须在下一个帧开始前读出. 因此,对于更黑暗的场景,被封顶的暴露会导致更多的噪音. 在SAI中,噪声一般倾向于运动模糊,因为运动模糊不能平均得出.

blocks.en: For the sensor stage we use the EMVA 1288 camera model ( European Machine Vision Association, 2021 ) . It describes how much light a pixel collects during the exposure and how noisy the recorded value is. The main noise source is shot noise, which comes from the random arrival of photons and gets worse the less light a pixel collects. On top of that, the readout adds a constant read noise. Very bright pixels saturate, and the result is written as an 8-bit image. The model needs only four numbers from the camera: quantum efficiency, pixel pitch, read noise and full-well capacity. We take all four from the EMVA 1288 measurement the manufacturer publishes for the camera we simulate (Section 4 ). The exposure is set so that a white surface fills the output range, like an auto exposure would do.
blocks.zh: 对于感应舞台,我们使用EMVA 1288相机模型(欧洲机器视觉协会,2021年) . 它描述了一个像素在曝光期间收集的光度和记录值的噪音。 主要噪声来源是镜头噪声,这些噪声来自光子的随机到达,而像素收集的光线越少,情况就越糟糕. 除此之外,读出会增加一个常读噪声. 非常亮的像素饱和,结果被写成8位图像. 该模型仅需要相机的4个数字:量子效率,像素投射,读噪声和全井容量. 我们从制造商公布的EMVA 1288测量仪中取出所有四个,用于我们模拟的照相机(第4节)。 暴露被设定为白色表面可以填充输出范围,就像汽车暴露那样.

blocks.en: 3.4. Synthetic-Aperture Reconstruction
blocks.zh: 3.4. 合成孔径重建

blocks.en: Both sensor simulations end on the same focal plane at depth z f z_{f} , using the AOS light-field renderer ( Kurmi et al., 2018 ) . Everything the camera saw from all viewpoints is projected onto this plane and added up. Objects at the selected depth are seen from every viewpoint at the same place, so they add up. The occluder in front of the plane lands somewhere else in every viewpoint, so it gets averaged out.
blocks.zh: 两种传感器模拟在深度z f z_{f}的同一焦平面上结束,使用AOS轻场渲染器(Kurmi等人,2018年). 摄影机从所有角度看到的一切 都投射到这架飞机上 然后加起来 选定深度的物体从同一地点的每一个角度都可以看到,所以它们加起来. 飞机前的占地者在每一处视线下落到别处,所以得到平均.

blocks.en: For the frames we use the image-based rendering of AOS ( Kurmi et al., 2018 ) . Every pixel of every recorded image is one ray through the synthetic aperture. A virtual camera is defined with its own pose, field of view and focal plane. For each pixel of this virtual camera, a ray is cast through its projection center and intersected with the focal plane. All recorded rays that pass through this point on the focal plane are integrated and normalized, and the result is the color of that pixel. Points on the focal plane are hit by rays from every viewpoint at the same place, so they add up. An occluder in front of the plane blocks only some of the rays and lands somewhere else in every viewpoint, so it is averaged out if it is sparse enough and the aperture is wide and densely sampled ( Kurmi et al., 2018 ) . No 3D reconstruction of the scene is needed for this.
blocks.zh: 对于帧,我们使用基于图像的AOS渲染(Kurmi等人,2018年). 每个记录图像的每个像素都是通过合成孔径的一线. 虚拟相机用自己的姿势,视野和焦平面来定义. 对于这个虚拟相机的每个像素,一个射线被投影中心投射,并与焦平面相交. 所有在焦平面上穿过这个点的被记录的射线都是集成和正常化的,结果就是那个像素的颜色. 焦平面上的点被射线从同一地点的每个角度击中,所以加起来. 在平面前的一个占地者在每一个角度上都只挡住一些射线并降落在别的地方,因此如果它足够稀疏,孔径宽广且采样稠密,则平均得出(Kurmi等人,2018年). 无需重建现场的3D.

blocks.en: Events are sparse, asynchronous and have a sign, so there is no image to project. We therefore integrate every event on its own, in two steps (Figure 2 ).
blocks.zh: 事件很少,是同步的,并且有一个标志,所以没有图像可以投影. 因此,我们把每个事件单独分为两个步骤(图2)。

blocks.en: From events to rays. Each event is stored with its pixel coordinates, its timestamp and polarity. The poses of the rendered frames are shared. An event fires while the camera moves, so its viewpoint is not one of the rendered poses. We estimate the pose of each event by interpolating between the two nearest poses. The position is interpolated linearly with the timestamp of the event, and the rotation along the shortest arc between the two rotations. This viewpoint is only as fine as the timestamps v2e assigns within a frame interval (Section 3.2 ), but it is still much finer than the rendered poses. Using the nearest rendered pose instead would collapse all events of one interval onto one viewpoint, and at high speed the aperture would then be sampled in coarse steps. The direction of the ray is given by the position of the pixel on the sensor. The offset of the pixel from the image center, divided by the focal length of the camera, gives the angle of the ray. A shorter focal length therefore spreads the same pixels over a wider angle, and each pixel looks in a slightly different direction. The focal length and the image center are the same for all events and are taken from the rendered camera. For an event at pixel ( x , y ) (x,y) the direction in the camera frame is 𝐝 = ( c x − x f x , c y − y f y , − 1 ) , \mathbf{d}=\left(\frac{c_{x}-x}{f_{x}},\ \frac{c_{y}-y}{f_{y}},\ -1\right), with the principal point ( c x , c y ) (c_{x},c_{y}) and the focal length ( f x , f y ) (f_{x},f_{y}) in pixels. The ray is then rotated into the world with the interpolated pose. This gives a ray in world space, together with the directions that span the footprint of one sensor pixel.

blocks.en: Splatting on the focal plane. Each ray is intersected with the focal plane and the footprint of its pixel is projected there. Seen from the side, this footprint is a distorted quadrilateral. The event deposits its polarity over this footprint with a tent weighting that is widened to twice the footprint. Neighboring events overlap on the plane and their weights sum to one, so the sparse events form a smooth surface. The weight of each event is divided by the projected area of the footprint. An event far from the optical axis, whose footprint projects larger, therefore has the same total weight as a central one. All splats are added up on the GPU, with ON and OFF polarity in separate channels. One quad is drawn per event, so the cost grows with the number of events. The rays do not depend on the focal depth, so refocusing to another z f z_{f} reuses all rays and only needs a redraw. After that, the final reconstruction counts the positive and negative events in each pixel, and we have two ways of visualizing the result. The first one takes the positive minus the negative count and maps it to gray, so that pixels where both polarities cancel are mid-gray. The second one takes the absolute value of this difference and inverts it, so cancelled pixels become white and pixels where one polarity dominates become dark.

blocks.en: 3.5. Event-Rate Controller
blocks.zh: 3.5. 活动时间控制器

blocks.en: A frame camera with a given frame rate always puts out the same amount of data. For event cameras it depends on the light and also very much on the scene itself ( Gallego et al., 2022 ) . For scenes where the camera is static, only very few events are produced. However, for scenes where the camera is moving and a lot of texture is captured, a lot of events are recorded. In such scenarios it can happen that the event camera produces more events than the link from the event camera can handle, especially for sensors with higher resolution like the one we are simulating in our experiments ( Gehrig and Scaramuzza, 2022 ; Finateu et al., 2020 ) . In older systems, when the link is saturated, events are dropped in an uncontrolled manner, which leads to signal loss, and the timestamps of the events get corrupted ( Gallego et al., 2022 ; Gehrig and Scaramuzza, 2022 ) . Modern systems ship with an event-rate controller (ERC) that drops events in a controlled manner and can be configured by setting an event rate per second ( Finateu et al., 2020 ) . In our high-speed scene the simulated event stream exceeds the link budget we estimate in Section 4.4 , so a real recording of this scenario would likely have the ERC active, and simulating the camera without ERC would be too optimistic.
blocks.zh: 具有特定帧速率的帧相机总是会输出同样数量的数据. 对于事件摄像头来说,它依赖于光线,也非常依赖于现场本身(Gallego等人,2022年). 对于镜头是静态的场景,只产生极少的事件. 然而,对于镜头在移动和捕捉大量纹理的场景,记录了许多事件. 在这样的情景下,事件摄像头产生的事件比事件摄像头能够处理的链接多,尤其是对于像我们在实验中模拟的分辨率较高的传感器(Gehrig and Scaramuzza, 2022; Fintitu等人, 2020年). 在更古老的系统中,当连接饱和时,事件会以无节制的方式抛下,导致信号丢失,事件的时间戳会腐败(Gallego等人,2022年;Gehrig和Scaramuzza,2022年). 现代系统搭载一个事件率控制器(ERC),以可控的方式放下事件,并且可以通过设定事件率每秒进行配置(Fenitu等人,2020年). 在我们的高速场景中,模拟事件流超过了我们在第4.4节中估计的链接预算,因此真实地记录这一场景很可能会让ERC活动,而模拟没有ERC的相机会过于乐观.

blocks.en: However, how exactly the ERC decides which events to drop is not published, so we follow the description of Gehrig and Scaramuzza ( Gehrig and Scaramuzza, 2022 ) and use a uniform dropping algorithm. The event stream is split into short counting periods, and whenever a period contains more events than the configured rate allows, the surplus is dropped at random. The event rate and the counting period we use are given in Section 4 .
blocks.zh: 然而,ERC究竟如何决定哪些事件降级没有公布,所以我们遵循Gehrig和Scaramuzza(Gehrig和Scaramuzza,2022年)的描述,使用统一的降级算法. 事件流被分割为短的计数周期,每当某一期间包含的事件超过配置的速率允许时,剩余部分会随机减少. 第4节列出了事件率和我们使用的计算期限。

blocks.en: 4. Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4. 实验设置

blocks.en: The comparison uses a scene with two bushes as occluders and a bicycle behind them (Figure 4 ). The bicycle is about 9 9 m away from the camera. The camera moves 0.5 0.5 m along the occluders and rises slightly while doing so, which makes the path a diagonal shift without any rotation. Although our event integration works with arbitrary 6-DoF poses, we keep to this simple movement, because Bimber et al. ( Bimber et al., 2025 ) found that a lateral shift suppresses occluders better than a rotation, as it maximizes the parallax, and that a vertical component on top of it also helps against horizontally aligned occluders. This movement is what is rendered. We chose this rather short aperture on purpose. With a long aperture of several meters both sensors get more than enough views, the two results converge, and the differences we want to show disappear. The short aperture is where a shortage of views actually hurts. Our simulation is also optimistic, because the poses are known exactly. A real system has pose errors and needs even more views to average them out, so the situation we create here with a short aperture would show up on a real system at larger apertures too. We render 3000 frames for this movement to make high cutoff_hz settings possible. This render is only done once. The scene has one global light in Blender. The resolution of the Blender render is 720 × 720 720\times 720 pixels. We compare the sensors at the same resolution to make bandwidth comparisons fair.

blocks.en: 4.1. Two Operating Points
blocks.zh: 4.1. 两个操作点

blocks.en: The comparison is done at two operating points and one additional run, listed in Table 1 . The first operating point is a bright high-speed scenario, where the speed of the camera is 25 25 m/s. Here we want to see if the event camera can still produce a good reconstruction when the frame camera is starved of frames, because at 160 160 fps the frame camera only records three frames during the movement. The second operating point is a low-light scenario. The movement here is much slower at 5 5 m/s, and therefore the frame camera has enough frames to create a good result in principle, so this is all about sensor noise in a low-lit environment. We use 5 5 lux, because this is the lowest illuminance for which Prophesee, the manufacturer of the event sensor, still specifies a latency value ( Prophesee and Sony Semiconductor Solutions, 2021 ) . The scene, the path and the render are the same at both comparisons. A third run in the bright scene at 1 1 m/s is used to compare reconstruction quality at two approximately matched data budgets (Section 5.3 ). We pair an ERC cap of 20 20 MEv/s with 80 80 frames at 160 160 fps, and 10 10 MEv/s with 40 40 frames at 80 80 fps. The 40 40 -frame sequence takes every second frame of the original 80 80 -frame sequence, preserving the exposure and noise realizations. Both pairs cover the same 0.5 0.5 s traversal; only the frame sampling rate and the ERC cap change.

The exposure can never be longer than the 6.25 6.25 ms frame interval. At night we use this full interval, so the frame camera collects as much light as a 160 160 fps global-shutter sensor can. In the bright scenario we use a 0.1 0.1 ms exposure. The image moves about 1.5 1.5 px/ms at 25 25 m/s, so the motion blur stays around 0.15 0.15 px, and the result is limited by the three frames on the path and not by blur or noise. These choices are the best case for the frame camera at each operating point.
blocks.zh: 量子效率,像素投球,读噪声,全井容量和帧速率来自巴斯勒出版的EMVA 1288测量(Basler AG,2024). 接触时间永远不能超过6.25 6.25 ms帧间隔. 晚上我们使用这个完整的间隔,所以帧相机收集的光线与160,160英尺的全球-舒特传感器可以一样多. 在明亮的情况下,我们使用0.1 0.1毫秒的接触。 图像以25 m/s的速度移动约1.5 px/ms,因此运动模糊度保持在0.15 0.15 px左右,结果受到路径上的三帧限制,而不是模糊或噪音. 这些选择是每个操作点的帧相机的最佳案例.

The photoreceptor cutoff has no datasheet value and is treated in Section 4.3 .

blocks.en: 4.3. Photoreceptor Cutoff
blocks.zh: 4.3. 光受体截断

blocks.en: To our knowledge there is no published measurement of the photoreceptor bandwidth of the IMX636 at a known illuminance ( McReynolds et al., 2024 ) , so we cannot look up cutoff_hz and have to choose it. We base the choice on two sources.
blocks.zh: 据我们所知,在已知的光照下(McReynolds等人,2024年),没有公布对IMX636的光受体带宽的测量结果,因此我们无法查看断面-hz,不得不选择. 我们的选择基于两个来源。

blocks.en: The first one is the original DVS. Its bandwidth was measured directly: about 3 3 kHz at 1 1 klux and about 300 300 Hz at a thousand times less light ( Lichtsteiner et al., 2008 ; Gallego et al., 2022 ) . That sensor had much larger pixels than the IMX636. Smaller pixels collect less light and get slower in the dark ( Gehrig and Scaramuzza, 2022 ) , so the IMX636 should have lower cutoff values at the same light levels.
blocks.zh: 第一个是最初的DVS. 它的带宽被直接测量:在1千卢克时约3个3千赫,在减少一千倍光度时约300个300赫(Lichtstener等人,2008年;Gallego等人,2022年). 该传感器的像素比IMX636大得多. 较小的像素收集光线较少,在黑暗中变慢(Gehrig and Scaramuzza, 2022),因此IMX636在同样光线水平上应该有较低的截断值.

blocks.en: The second one is the product brief of the IMX636. It gives the latency of the sensor: 100 100 µs at 1 1 klux and 1000 1000 µs at 5 5 lux ( Prophesee and Sony Semiconductor Solutions, 2021 ) . We use the latency as the time constant of the cutoff filter, so the cutoff is f c = 1 / ( 2 ​ π ​ t lat ) f_{c}=1/(2\pi\,t_{\text{lat}}) . This is an assumption, since the latency also depends on the contrast of the step. With a higher contrast the pixel fires a little earlier, but the datasheet does not say which contrast was used. With it, the two latencies give 1.6 1.6 kHz and 160 160 Hz.
blocks.zh: 第二个是IMX636的产品简介. 它给出了感应器的耐久性: 1 1 千卢克时100 μs, 5 5 lux时1000 μs(预言和索尼半导体解决方案, 2021). 我们使用延迟作为截断过滤器的时间常数,所以截断是 f c = 1 / (2 π t lat ) f _{ c}= 1 / (2\pi\,t_{\ text{lat}} ). 这是一个假设,因为延迟也取决于步骤的对比. 比较高的对比度,像素的点火稍早一点,但数据表并没有说明使用了哪一种对比度. 有了它,两个ladness给出1.6 kHz和160 Hz.

blocks.en: We stay below both sources and use 1000 1000 Hz for the bright scenario and 100 100 Hz for the night scenario. The lux values of the brief are the manufacturer’s test conditions, and we take them as our scene illuminances.
blocks.zh: 我们停留在源头以下,使用1000千赫的亮度情景和100100赫的夜间情景。 简讯的奢侈值是制造商的测试条件,我们把它们当作我们的场景亮点。

blocks.en: 4.4. Event-Rate Budget
blocks.zh: 4.4. 活动时间预算

blocks.en: The ERC model is described in Section 3.5 . Here we give the two values it needs, the event rate and the counting period.
blocks.zh: 第3.5节介绍了ERC模式。 在这里,我们给出它所需要的两个值,事件率和计时期.

blocks.en: The event rate follows from how fast the camera can get its events to the computer. The IMX636 is sold in Prophesee’s EVK4 camera, which is connected over USB 3.0 and has a maximum bandwidth of 1.6 1.6 Gbit/s ( Prophesee, 2026a ) . How many events fit through this link depends on the size of one event. The sensor packs its events into the EVT3 format, which only transmits what changes between neighboring events, so the size of an event depends on the scene ( Prophesee, 2024 ) . We estimate the data rate using 4 4 bytes per event. This is a working approximation rather than a strict upper bound for EVT3. For context, Prophesee’s published RAW EVT3 recordings yield approximately 2.8 2.8 bytes per event for high-speed laser motion, 3.2 3.2 for a moving-camera driving sequence and 4.7 4.7 for pedestrians, calculated from their listed file sizes, durations and event rates ( Prophesee, 2026b ) . Using our four-byte estimate, the link supports 1.6 × 10 9 / ( 8 × 4 ) = 50 ​ MEv/s . 1.6\times 10^{9}/(8\times 4)=50\,\text{MEv/s}. To be safe we also run the ERC at 20 20 MEv/s, well below any plausible link rate. Events are counted in periods of 200 200 µs, the reference period of the IMX636 ERC ( Finateu et al., 2020 ) . The bright stream at 25 25 m/s is about 177 177 MEv/s and therefore exceeds the estimated link budget by about 3.5 × 3.5\times , which motivates the ERC experiments. That reconstruction is repeated after the ERC at both rates. The night 5 5 m/s stream at the 100 100 Hz cutoff is about 21 21 MEv/s, under budget, and is left as it is.
blocks.zh: 事件速率从摄像头能够将其事件迅速带到计算机上. IMX636在预言的EVK4相机中发售,该相机通过USB 3.0连接,最大带宽为1.61.6Gbit/s(预言,2026a). 多少事件适合通过这个链接取决于一个事件的大小. 感应器将其事件打包成EVT3格式,该格式只传递邻接事件之间的变化,因此事件大小取决于场景(Prophesee, 2024). 我们用每件事件4 4字节来估计数据率。 这是工作近似,而不是EVT3严格的上限. 对于背景,Prophesee出版的RAW EVT3录音在高速激光运动中每场活动产生约2.82.8字节,在移动相机驱动序列中产生3.23.2字节,在行人中产生4.74.7字节,根据列出的文件大小,持续时间和事件率计算(Prophesee,2026b). 使用我们的四字节估计,链接支持1.6×10 9 / (8×4)=50 Mev/s. 1.6\times 10×9}/(8\times 4)=50\,\text{Mev/s}. 为了安全起见,我们还以20兆瓦/秒的速度运行ERC,远低于任何可信的连接率. 事件按200200μs的时期计算,即IMX636 ERC的参考期(Fenitu等人,2020年). 25 m/s的亮流约177 177 Mev/s,因此超过估计的链接预算约3.5×3.5\时,这激励了ERC的实验. 这种重建在紧急救济协调员之后以两种速度重复。 100赫兹截流线的夜晚5 5 m/s 大约为21 21 Mev/s,在预算下,并保持原样.

blocks.en: 5. Results
blocks.zh: 5.五. 结果

blocks.en: Reconstruction quality is assessed qualitatively. We look at whether the bicycle can be recognized, which structures are visible, such as the spokes, the frame and the foliage that should be washed out, and how noisy the image is. The conclusions apply to the two operating points in Table 1 and to the additional run at 1 1 m/s, and not to the speeds and illuminances between them. Section 5.3 then compares the data the two cameras produce in all three runs.
blocks.zh: 对重建质量进行质量评估。 我们审视一下自行车是否可以识别,哪些结构是可见的,比如说话器,框和应该冲掉的叶片,以及图像有多吵. 这些结论适用于表1中的两个操作点和1米/秒的额外运行点,而不适用于它们之间的速度和亮度。 第5.3节然后比较这两台相机在所有三次运行中产生的数据。

blocks.en: 5.1. High Speed

At 25 25 m/s and 1000 1000 lux the frame camera records three frames on the path. Figure 5 shows both reconstructions. The three images the frame camera produces are not enough to create a good reconstruction. Some parts of the bike are still visible, but that is only because the occlusion is not very dense, as shown in Figure 4 . The input frames are well exposed and do not have any noise problems. The event camera at the same time captures 3.5 3.5 M events along the same path, and when looking at its result it is clear that the event reconstruction gives us the whole bike. However, the raw event data we get at this combination of speed and cutoff_hz is above the link budget we estimated in Section 4.4 . Therefore we also added two reconstructions after an event-rate controller simulation. When the ERC limit is set to 50 50 MEv/s, about two thirds of the events are dropped, but the reconstruction still shows the bike, at the cost of detail and noise. We also did the same with an event budget of 20 20 MEv/s. The bike is still recognizable, but the quality degrades further and there is less detail. The data behind these images is compared in Section 5.3 .
blocks.zh: 在25 25 m/s和1000 1000 lux时,帧相机记录路径上的三帧. 图5显示这两处重建情况。 帧相机制作的三幅图像不足以创造良好的重建. 如图4所示,机车的某些部分仍然可见,但这仅仅是因为闭塞不十分密集。 输入框暴露得很好,没有任何噪音问题。 事件摄像头同时捕获了沿着同一路径的3.53.5M事件,在看结果时,很明显事件重建给了我们整个自行车. 然而,我们从速度和截断量的组合中获得的原始事件数据高于我们在4.4节中估计的链接预算。 因此,我们还在一次事件率控制器模拟之后增加了两次重建。 当ERC的极限被设定为50 MEv/s时,大约三分之二的事件被放弃,但重建仍然显示机车,以细节和噪音为代价. 我们也做了同样的事情 20 Mev/s。 机车仍可识别,但质量进一步退化,细节较少. 第5.3节比较了这些图像背后的数据。

blocks.en: 5.3. Bandwidth

We distinguish the data rate in MB/s, which determines whether a stream fits through the camera link, and the data volume that is used as input for one reconstruction. Table 4 reports both, using the estimate of 4 4 bytes per event from Section 4.4 and 8 8 bits per pixel for the frames. These are payload estimates.
blocks.zh: 我们用 MB/s 来区分数据速率,它决定一个流是否适合通过相机链接,以及用作一个重建输入的数据量. 表4按4.4节中每件事件4个字节的估计数和每帧8个比特的估计数报告两者。 这些是有效载荷估计数。

blocks.en: The raw high-speed event stream produces about 709 709 MB/s, exceeding the estimated 200 200 MB/s link budget. At an ERC cap of 20 20 MEv/s, one traversal produces approximately 1.6 1.6 MB, comparable to the three frames, while the bicycle remains more recognizable in the event reconstruction (Figure 5 ). At night the two streams produce similar volumes, 8.6 8.6 MB for events and 8.3 8.3 MB for frames. The raw bright stream at 1 1 m/s fits within the estimated link budget, but its 86.7 86.7 MB per traversal exceeds the 41.5 41.5 MB of the 80 80 frames.
blocks.zh: 原始高速事件流的产量约为709,709 MB/s,超过了估计的200 MB/s连线预算. 在20 Mev/s的ERC封顶下,一个转盘生产约1.6 1.6 MB,可与三帧相媲美,而自行车在事件重建中仍然更能识别(图5). 晚上,两条溪流产生类似的卷,8.6 8.6 MB用于活动,8.3 8.3 MB用于帧。 1 1 m/s的生亮流符合估计的链接预算,但其每转弯86.7 86.7 MB超过80帧的41.5 41.5 MB。

blocks.en: For the bright 1 1 m/s run, we therefore reduce the data on both sides and compare two approximately matched budgets (Figure 7 ). The first pair uses the ERC at 20 20 MEv/s and 80 80 frames at 160 160 fps, producing 39.6 39.6 and 41.5 41.5 MB per traversal. The second pair halves both settings: the ERC at 10 10 MEv/s produces 19.8 19.8 MB, and 40 40 frames at 80 80 fps produce 20.7 20.7 MB.
blocks.zh: 因此,对于1米/秒的亮度,我们减少两边的数据,比较两个大致相当的预算(图7)。 第一对采用20 Mev/s的ERC,160 160 fps的80 帧,每曲面生产39.6 39.6和41.5 41.5 MB. 第二对将两种设置都减半:10 MEv/s的ERC生产出19.8 19.8 MB,80 fps的40 40帧生产出20.7 20.7 MB.

blocks.en: Event cameras are often seen as very efficient and less bandwidth hungry ( Gallego et al., 2022 ) , although some research already shows that this is not the case for all scenarios ( Gehrig and Scaramuzza, 2022 ) . With a stationary camera, events come only from the moving targets, while with a moving camera the whole static scene triggers events ( Gallego et al., 2022 ) . SAI is exactly the second case, a moving camera and a stationary scene. In addition, SAI is all about occluders, and occluders have a lot of texture that produces a lot of events, because the event rate grows with the image gradient and the speed on the sensor ( Gallego et al., 2022 ) . In the 1 1 m/s comparison with matched budgets the event camera has no advantage over the frame camera in terms of reconstruction quality. Especially in the 10 10 MEv/s case the frame camera retains almost all of the detail with 40 40 frames, while the event camera loses some detail compared to the higher budget.
blocks.zh: 事件摄像头通常被视为非常高效,带宽饥饿程度较低(Gallego等人,2022年),不过一些研究已经表明,并非所有情景都如此(Gehrig和Scaramuzza,2022年)。 使用固定相机,事件只来自移动目标,而使用移动相机,整个静态场景触发事件(Gallego等人,2022年). 最高审计机关正是第二个案件,一个移动的摄像机和一个固定的场景。 此外,SAI也完全涉及了占卜器,占卜器有很多的纹理,产生很多事件,因为事件率随着图像梯度和传感器上的速度而增长(Gallego等人,2022年). 在1 1 m/s与匹配预算的比较中,事件相机在重建质量方面比帧相机没有优势. 特别是在10 10 MEv/s的情况下,帧相机几乎保留了全部细节,有40帧,而事件相机与较高的预算相比,损失了一些细节.

blocks.en: The only bandwidth advantage we could see was at very high speed. At slower speeds this advantage seems to vanish in our simulation.
blocks.zh: 我们唯一能看到的带宽优势是高速 以较慢的速度,这个优势似乎在我们模拟中消失了.

blocks.en: 6. Discussion
blocks.zh: 6个 讨论情况

blocks.en: The high-speed run shows the clearest difference. The deficit of the frame camera there cannot be resolved by adjusting the exposure. At the tested speed and aperture length, more viewpoints are needed, which the event camera provides through its finer temporal sampling.
blocks.zh: 高速运行显示最明显差异. 那里的帧相机的不足无法通过调整曝光量来解决. 在测试速度和孔径长度时,需要更多的视点,而事件相机通过更精细的时间采样提供这些视点.

blocks.en: In low light the two cameras reach similar quality, but we used a cutoff_hz at the low end of the range discussed in Section 4.3 . The original DVS reached about 300 300 Hz at 1 1 lux ( Lichtsteiner et al., 2008 ; Gallego et al., 2022 ) , suggesting a better low-light temporal response than the high-resolution sensor model used here. However, its lower spatial resolution comes at a cost: it can limit the fine detail available to the SAI reconstruction. As shown by Gehrig and Scaramuzza ( Gehrig and Scaramuzza, 2022 ) , lower-resolution event cameras can perform better in low light and at high speed for several tasks. For SAI, this benefit must therefore be weighed against the loss of spatial detail. Our comparison evaluates one choice within this tradeoff.
blocks.zh: 在低光下,两台相机达到相似的质量,但我们在4.3节讨论的射程的低端使用了截断(cutoff_hz). 最初的DVS在1 1 lux时达到了大约300 Hz(Lichtstener等人,2008年;Gallego等人,2022年),表明比这里使用的高分辨率传感器模型更好的低光时间反应. 然而,它的低空间分辨率代价高昂:它可以限制SAI重建可用的细微细节. 如Gehrig和Scaramuzza(Gehrig和Scaramuzza,2022年)所示,低分辨率事件摄像头在低光线下和高速下可以更好的表现完成多项任务. 因此,对最高审计机关而言,必须权衡这种利益与空间细节的丧失。 我们的比较评估了这种权衡中的一个选择。

blocks.en: At approximately matched bandwidth budgets in the bright 1 1 m/s run, the event camera has no advantage in target-detail preservation. Especially at the lower budget, the 40 40 frames retain slightly more detail than the 10 10 MEv/s event stream. At this speed, even the reduced frame rate supplies enough viewpoints to retain the bicycle, so the finer temporal sampling of the event camera provides less benefit. Its data rate also depends on the scene and, among our runs, is highest in the fast, bright condition where its clearest advantage appears. A system that adopts an event camera for high-speed SAI must therefore account for this high event rate and the event removal required by its link budget.
blocks.zh: 在闪亮的11米/秒运行中,在大约匹配的带宽预算下,事件相机在目标细节保存方面没有优势. 特别是在下层预算中,40帧保留的细节略高于10 MEv/s事件流. 在这个速度下,即使降低的帧率也提供足够的视角来保留自行车,因此事件相机的细微时间采样提供了较少的好处. 它的数据率也取决于场景,在我们运行中,在它最明显优势显现的快速,明亮的条件下最高. 因此,采用高速SAI事件摄像头的系统必须考虑到这种高事件率及其链接预算所要求的事件清除。

blocks.en: Another factor could be that at higher speeds the event camera records fewer events from the occluders, since motion parallax makes them move much faster across the sensor than the target. The limited photoreceptor bandwidth may attenuate these fast brightness changes more strongly. At lower speeds, more occluder events may survive and consume part of the ERC budget. This possible filtering occurs before the ERC, which drops events randomly in our model. But this is still an open question.
blocks.zh: 另一个因素可能是,事件摄像头以更高的速度记录了来自占卜器的事件较少,因为运动抛射器使得它们跨越传感器的速度远快于目标. 有限的光受体带宽可能会更强烈地削弱这些快速亮度的变化. 以较低的速度,更多的占卜事件可能会幸存下来,消耗部分ERC预算. 这种可能的过滤发生在 ERC 之前,它随机地在我们的模型中减少事件. 但这仍然是一个未决问题。

blocks.en: We tested high speed only in bright light. To see whether the event advantage survives in the dark, we repeated the 25 25 m/s run with the 5 5 lux settings of the night scenario, the 100 100 Hz cutoff and the 10 10 Hz per pixel shot noise, for the event camera only (Figure 8 ). The bicycle is barely recognizable: only a faint outline of one wheel remains, and the foliage is not averaged out. At 5 5 lux the time constant of the photoreceptor is about 1.6 1.6 ms, while a pixel crossing at 25 25 m/s takes about 0.7 0.7 ms, so most edges are filtered away before they trigger an event. The stream drops to about 23 23 MEv/s, so the link is not the limit here, the pixel is. The frame camera would record three noisy frames with 9 9 px of motion blur in this condition, so neither camera works, and the event advantage at high speed is limited to good light with this sensor model.
blocks.zh: 我们只在光亮下测试高速 为了了解事件优势是否在黑暗中生存,我们重复了25 25 m/s与夜景的5个5个豪华设置,100赫兹的截断和每像素的10个10赫兹的镜头噪声,仅用于事件相机(图8). 自行车几乎无法辨认:只有一个轮子留下的微弱轮廓,叶片不平均. 在5 5 lux时,光子受体的时间常数约为1.6 1.6 ms,而像素在25 25 m/s时的穿越需要约0.7 0.7 ms,因此大多数边缘在触发事件前被过滤掉. 溪流下降至约23 23 MEv/s,因此链接不是这里的极限,像素就是. 帧相机会记录三个吵闹的帧,在这种状态下9 9 px的动作模糊,所以两个相机都没有作用,在高速上的事件优势仅限于使用这种传感器模型的好光.

blocks.en: A speed of 25 25 m/s is relevant to fast-flying drones, and event cameras have already been flown on drones ( Sun et al., 2021 ) , though not for SAI. If at least ten frames are needed over the aperture to suppress the occluders, a 30 30 fps camera on our 0.5 0.5 m aperture is limited to 1.5 1.5 m/s, and the 160 160 fps camera we simulate to 8 8 m/s. The event camera gave a usable result at 25 25 m/s, a factor of about 17 17 over the 30 30 fps camera. The faster traversal also matters when the target moves.
blocks.zh: 25米/秒的速度与快速飞行无人机相关,事件摄像头已经在无人机上飞行过(Sun等人,2021年),虽然不是SAI. 如果在孔径上至少需要10帧来压制闭塞,那么我们0.5米孔径上的30个30英尺摄像头限制在1.51.5米/秒,我们模拟的160个160英尺摄像头限制在8米/秒. 事件摄像头给出了25米/秒的可用结果,30英尺的摄像头的系数约为17 17. 当目标移动时,转速越快也很重要。

blocks.en: Accurate pose estimation remains a practical limitation for high-speed event-based SAI. Recent event-inertial methods explicitly address aggressive motion, including continuous-time estimation of linear velocity ( Lu et al., 2025 ) , while newer benchmarks evaluate pose estimators on drone trajectories reaching 8.64 8.64 m/s ( Zhong et al., 2026 ) . These studies support the feasibility of estimating motion from events and inertial measurements, but also show that reliable estimation under general high-speed motion remains challenging. Whether the resulting trajectories provide sufficient accuracy for SAI at the 25 25 m/s operating point tested here remains unverified.
blocks.zh: 对基于高速事件的SAI来说,准确的估计仍然是实际限制。 近期的事件惯性方法明确涉及攻击性运动,包括对线性速度的连续时间估计(Lu等人,2025年),而较新的基准评价则对无人机轨迹作出估计,达到8.64 8.64米/秒(Zhong等人,2026年)。 这些研究支持从事件和惯性测量中估计运动的可行性,但也表明,在一般高速运动下可靠的估计仍然具有挑战性. 由此产生的轨迹在此处测试的25 25 m/s操作点是否为SAI提供了足够的准确性,仍未验证.

blocks.en: Denser occlusion was not tested in our experiments. For frames, Kurmi et al. ( Kurmi et al., 2019a ) show that denser occlusion lowers the visibility, and adding more frames does not improve the result after a certain threshold and never reaches the same result as with less occlusion. For events, the only study we know of is Yu et al. ( Yu et al., 2022 ) , whose reconstruction improved with denser occlusion. That test used a fence and cut cardboard with a trained network, so it does not tell us how plain integration behaves behind foliage.
blocks.zh: 我们的实验中没有测试登泽隔离 对于帧,Kurmi等人. (Kurmi等人,2019年a) 显示更密集的隐蔽能降低能见度,增加更多帧并不能改善在一定阈值后的结果,也永远不会达到少隐蔽能见度的相同结果. 对于事件,我们所知的唯一研究是余等人. (Yu et al., 2022),其重建随着密集的隐蔽性而改善. 该测试使用栅栏和用训练有素的网络切割纸板,所以它没有告诉我们叶片后面的平坦融合行为.

blocks.en: The comparisons are qualitative, and we only test one scene with mild occlusion. The estimation of the cutoff frequency is grounded but not verified with a real sensor. The ERC modeling is also an estimation. Therefore a difference would have to be substantial to infer an advantage, which we only had in the high-speed case. Also, the comparison excluded any HDR comparison, and HDR is definitely a big factor when considering event cameras.
blocks.zh: 比较是质的,我们只测试一个场景 以温和的隔离。 截断频率的估算被禁足,但没有用真正的传感器进行验证. ERC的模型化也是一个估计. 因此,必须有实质性的差别才能推断出我们只在高速情况下才有的优势。 此外,比较不包括任何人类发展报告的比较,在考虑事件摄像头时,人类发展报告无疑是一个重要因素。

blocks.en: 7. Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7. 结论

blocks.en: We built a simulation pipeline in which a frame camera and an event camera see the same rendered scene and the same camera movement, and compared them for synthetic-aperture imaging. An event-native version of the AOS SAI was added. The comparison shows an advantage for the event camera at high-speed movements on a short path. This holds in good light. In the dark at the same speed, the event reconstruction also failed to recover the target clearly; the frame camera would remain undersampled. For the tested 0.5 0.5 m aperture and an assumed minimum of ten frames, this corresponds to approximately 17 17 times the traversal speed of a 30 30 fps camera. The expected bandwidth efficiency of event cameras was not confirmed, because of the many events produced by the occlusion and the non-static camera setting. For low light no advantage could be found with the two selected sensors, although this does not mean that other event cameras with smaller resolution do not have an advantage at low light. In general the HDR advantage is still a very compelling argument to choose event cameras for synthetic aperture. If there is a usage scenario that needs the higher dynamic range, there is no reason to believe that this advantage should not transfer directly to SAI. In general event cameras are a viable option for SAI, but the advantages are not as big as expected. Future work should validate the simulation with real recordings, in particular the photoreceptor bandwidth of the event sensor in low light.
blocks.zh: 我们搭建了一个模拟管道 一个帧相机和一个事件相机 看到了同样的场景 和同样的相机运动 把它们比作合成孔径成像 增加了AOS SAI的事件本土版本. 比较显示事件相机在短路高速移动上的优势. 光线很好 在同样速度的黑暗中,事件重建也未能清晰地恢复目标;帧相机将保持未加取样. 对于测试的0.5米孔径和假设的最低10帧,这相当于30个30英尺相机的转速的17倍。 事件摄像头的预期带宽效率没有得到确认,因为封存和非静态摄像头设置产生了许多事件. 就低光而言,两个选定的传感器没有优势,虽然这并不意味着其他分辨率较小的事件摄像机在低光下没有优势。 总的来说,人类发展报告的优势仍然是选择合成孔径事件摄像头的一个非常令人信服的论点。 如果使用假想需要更高的动态范围,就没有理由认为这种优势不应直接转移到SAI. 一般情况下,相机是SAI的一个可行的选择,但优点并没有预期的那么大. 今后的工作应当以真实录音验证模拟,特别是事件传感器在低光线下的光受器带宽.
